warnings: This paper tests amino acid biostimulant (protein hydrolysate category) with 3 different doses - each dose should be extracted separately vs control

Control definition is clear but treatment groups have 3 different application rates

recon.control_definition: Control plot with no fertilizer, only with water
recon.treatment_definition: Three experimental plots sprayed with Microfert amino acid fertilizer at doses of 1.8, 3.0, and 4.5 L/ha
recon.sample_size_source: The field trial was set up as a randomized block design with four replications (plot size of 10m2)
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract seed yield data from Table 3. Control is 'control' row, treatments are 1.8, 3.0, and 4.5 L/ha doses. Each dose vs control should be extracted as separate comparisons. Use either individual year data or mean values depending on meta-analysis protocol. Variance values appear to be standard deviations. Note this is seed yield, not fresh biomass yield - confirm this fits inclusion criteria.
